launch_mechanism: transient shell backgrounded exec setsid --wait ./launcher.sh; command.sh execs the helper
termination_evidence: No wait(2) exit status is available after the transient launcher shell exits. On authorized stop, retain pre-signal PID/startticks identity, record signal-dispatch status, then poll /proc/PID and kill -0 until absence while checking no replacement PID has a different startticks; also record listener closure. Signal success or PID disappearance alone is not represented as exit 0.
